## Walkthrough

All eleven TAS e2e test suite files now include Ginkgo labels (`area:tas` and feature-specific identifiers) in their `ginkgo.Describe` declarations to enable selective test filtering and categorization.

## Changes

**TAS Test Suite Labeling**

| Layer / File(s) | Summary |
|---|---|
| **Add area and feature labels to TAS test suite definitions** <br> `test/e2e/tas/baseline/hotswap_test.go`, `test/e2e/tas/baseline/job_test.go`, `test/e2e/tas/baseline/pod_group_test.go`, `test/e2e/tas/baseline/statefulset_test.go`, `test/e2e/tas/extended/appwrapper_test.go`, `test/e2e/tas/extended/jobset_test.go`, `test/e2e/tas/extended/leaderworkerset_test.go`, `test/e2e/tas/extended/mpijob_test.go`, `test/e2e/tas/extended/pytorch_test.go`, `test/e2e/tas/extended/rayjob_test.go`, `test/e2e/tas/extended/trainjob_test.go` | Each test file's top-level `ginkgo.Describe` call now includes `ginkgo.Label` arguments with `area:tas` and feature-specific labels (`feature:hotswap`, `feature:job`, `feature:pod`, `feature:statefulset`, `feature:appwrapper`, `feature:jobset`, `feature:leaderworkerset`, `feature:mpijob`, `feature:pytorchjob`, `feature:kuberay`, `feature:trainjob`), alongside existing shard labels like `util.Shard1` or `util.Shard0`. |
